title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. to Host Second Quarter 2012 Earnings Webcast
summary: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. (Inland American) will host an earnings webcast to discuss its second-quarter and year-to-date 2012 results as well as portfolio strategies for the second half of the year on Thursday, August 23, 2012 at 10 a.m. Central time. Speakers will include Brenda Gujral, president of Inland American, Jack Potts, principal financial officer of Inland American, Tom McGuinness, president of Inland American Business Manager Advisor, and Tom Lithgow, president of Inland American HOLDCO. The live webcast and presentation will be available on Inland Americans website at www.inlandamerican.com. Listeners should log on approximately 10 minutes in advance to ensure proper setup to receive the webcast. A replay will be available on the Inland American website following the webcast.
